# Protect Affordable Colleges.
As a first-generation West County native and alumnus of Contra Costa and Diablo Valley Community Colleges, I have spent a lifetime supporting students and advocating for equal access to an affordable, quality education.
I am the only candidate in this race who is a union member, statewide legislative advocate on issues directly facing community college students and their families, and a current West County elected official.
JOIN US!
# Protect Affordable Colleges.
As a first-generation West County native and alumnus of Contra Costa and Diablo Valley Community Colleges, I have spent a lifetime supporting students and advocating for equal access to an affordable, quality education.
I am the only candidate in this race who is a union member, statewide legislative advocate on issues directly facing community college students and their families, and a current West County elected official.
JOIN US!
###### Priorities
## As your Community College Trustee, I’ll bring a fresh, hands-on approach to the following priorities:
## Protecting the affordability of our local community colleges.
## Preventing cuts to core college curriculum.
## Ensuring District transparency and community accountability.
## Attracting and retaining experienced faculty and educational staff.
Learn More
##### With Trump’s attacks on public education, there has never been a more important time to protect affordability, equity and diversity in our community colleges.
## Endorsed by California Attorney General Rob Bonta
"There’s a relentless pursuit and commitment to do better – to be better, to fight for justice, to not accept the unacceptable, to deliver solutions, to lift up people, to be on the front edge on all issues, making a difference for the people—and that spirit lives in Mayor Sasai,” Bonta said.
“It’s who he is. It’s how he fights, it’s how he rolls."
